desc:
Welcome to Chop for Eggs! 🪓🥚

Swing your Axe, chop down trees, and hatch as many Pets as you can! Every swing makes you stronger, so you can chop tougher trees, unlock new zones, find rarer Eggs and hatch MYTHICAL Pets! 🐾✨

How to play:
🪓 Swing to gain +1 Chop Power
🌲 Chop through trees to reach new zones
🥚 Grab Eggs and hatch them into Pets
🛡️ Sneak past the zone Guards, or they'll catch you!
💥 Get stronger Axes to chop even faster
🐉 Collect rare and Mythical Pets to earn more Cash
📏 Bigger Eggs hatch BIGGER Pets that earn way more
🏗️ Upgrade your pen to hold even more Pets

💤 Your Pets earn Cash even while you're OFFLINE!

♻️ Rebirth to multiply your Cash and unlock new zones!

👍 Like the game and join the group for a FREE Pet!
